subject_and_construction:
Interior wall with doorway and four-pane window. Lucide door-closed: continuous frame and floor. Shared grid for equal window panes; omit sidewalls and knob to retain usable openings.
Keyshape SQUARE: exact SOLO48 envelope. Reviewer: clean centerlines and joins.

feedback: Bad stroke drawn. User requests clean centerlines, smooth curves, true straight lines, clean joins, consistent stroke and appropriate symmetry.
revision_summary: Straight shared window grid; consistent door corners and floor joins.
